mentions.name: waypoint.nvim
mentions.description: A Neovim bookmark plugin (waypoint.nvim) that adds bookmarking features missing from existing bookmark plugins, aimed at helping navigate large codebases the user didn't write.
mentions.problem: Navigating large, unfamiliar codebases at work makes it easy to get lost; existing bookmark plugins lack needed features.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a neovim plugin: https://github.com/patrick-sharp/waypoint.nvim

It's a bookmark plugin with a couple features I felt were missing from existing bookmark plugins. At my job I often have to navigate large codebases that I didn't write, and it's easy to get lost. This plugin should help with that.
